title: Hank Plona announces signing of Emondrek Erkins-Ford to 2026-27 roster
text:
Mahurin Family Foundation Head Coach Hank Plona announced on May 13 the addition of Emondrek Erkins-Ford, a 6-foot-9 rising senior, to the Western Kentucky Hilltoppers men’s basketball team for the 2026-27 season.
The signing brings Erkins-Ford to Western Kentucky after his previous season at Jacksonville State and two years at Eastern Florida State College in Cocoa, Florida. The move is expected to strengthen the team’s roster with experience and skill.
“Emondrek is going to be a great addition to our Hilltopper family,” said Plona. “He proved against us and many other Conference USA teams that he has the potential to be an all-league player. We expect him to come in, score, rebound and help us win. Emondrek has gotten better and better every year, and we’re excited to help him continue his journey toward being a successful pro.”
During the 2025-26 season at Jacksonville State, Erkins-Ford played in 28 games with seven starts for the Gamecocks, shooting 53 percent from the field. He averaged 8.6 points, 3.6 rebounds, and one assist per game while reaching double figures in scoring twelve times. His top performance was a season-high of 24 points on January 4 against Liberty.
Before joining Jacksonville State, Erkins-Ford contributed significantly at Eastern Florida State College where he helped lead his team to a combined record of 50 wins over two seasons along with postseason appearances in regional championships and district semifinals or quarterfinals each year.
As a sophomore during the 2024-25 campaign at Eastern Florida State College, he started most games while averaging double-digit points as well as notable numbers in rebounds, assists, blocks and steals per game—demonstrating both offensive efficiency (58 percent shooting) and defensive impact throughout his college career.
